EmailTemplate.description: When processing staff transfers case to Registrar Services.
EmailTemplate.name: Transfer Case to University Registrar Services (Advisors)
EmailTemplate.subject: Your case has been transferred
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Admission Services. Upon further review of your student’s question, Admission Services has transferred case number {!Case.Thread_Id} to University Registrar Services. If you need more information, you can find it on the case details in Salesforce.
Thank you,
Admission Services https://asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
